description: Parses the puzzle's own category lists and numbered clues with strict negation-aware classification (equality, not-equal, directly/immediately left or right of, next-to, somewhere left/right of, N houses between, in/not-in house N). Aborts with no note if any clue is unparsed, ambiguous, or if categories do not match the house count. Runs an exhaustive backtracking search over per-category house permutations with incremental constraint pruning and a step budget.
